instructions: Build a job board platform, one feature at a time
One feature = one branch, named feature/<name>
Never start a feature's frontend before its backend is tested and working
Never start the next feature, and never merge, before the human approves the current one
Do not add any dependency outside this file without asking first
If a requirement is ambiguous, ask before coding

backend.usage: Local PostgreSQL development and isolated integration tests

per_feature: 1. Backend: Prisma schema + migration, zod schemas, route handlers / server actions, authorization
3. Backend validation: call the endpoints for real and confirm the expected responses (success, invalid input, unauthorized, forbidden)
4. Frontend: UI that consumes the validated backend
7. Stop and ask for human validation, with a short report (what was built, how to try it, test results). Wait for approval
8. Write after each sessions what feature you've implemented and what to do next.

security: Authorization is checked server-side in every route handler and server action
All inputs validated with zod on the server, never trust the client
Users can only read/edit their own data (ownership check)
CV upload: restricted file type and max size, validated server-side
No secrets in code: use environment variables
frontend: Server data goes through TanStack Query
Every page handles loading, empty and error states
backend: Schema changes only through Prisma migrations

features.description: Sign up, log in and log out with Better Auth. Each user has one role: candidate, recruiter or admin. Routes and actions are restricted by role, checked server-side.
A recruiter creates, edits, publishes and deletes their own job offers (title, description, location, contract type, salary range, skills). Candidates can read published offers only.
Paginated list of published offers with keyword search and filters (location, contract type, skills, salary range). Filters are validated server-side and reflected in the URL.

A candidate applies to an offer with a CV upload (restricted type and size) and an optional message. A candidate sees their own applications and their status. A recruiter sees applications to their own offers and updates their status.
Recruiter-only page with charts and counters for their own offers: views, applications per offer, applications per status over time.
Admin-only area to review, hide or delete offers, and to suspend or reactivate users. Moderation actions are logged.
A candidate gets a personalized list of recommended offers, generated by AI from their experience, interests and CV. Each recommendation shows a short reason.

For a given offer and candidate, AI computes a match score from the CV and profile versus the offer description, with a short explanation. A recruiter sees the score on the applications to their own offers.

definition_of_done: Playwright e2e tests pass for the feature
